column1: Projected Competitive Balance Tax (fifth-time payor in 2026)
2025: Tax on CBT payroll of $318M with $241M, $261M, $281M, $301M thresholds and rates of 50, 62, 95, 110 percent as a fourth-time payor.
2024: $62,512,111 tax on CBT payroll of $316,192,828 with $237M, $257M, $277M, $297M and rates of 50, 62, 95, 110 percent as a third-time payor.
2023: $32,399,366 tax on CBT payroll of $296,332,629 with $233M threshold and rates of 30, 42, 75 and 90 percent as a second-time payor.
2022: $9,681,903 tax on CBT payroll of $267,753,417 with $230M threshold and rates of 20 and 32 percent as a first-time payor.
2021: The Yankees CBT payroll of $208,418,540 did not exceed the $210M threshold for MLB's competitive balance tax.
2020: CBT payroll of $239,823,270. $208M threshold, 30 percent rate as second-time payor, surtax for amount over $228M. MLB suspended tax for 2020
2019: $6,742,435 tax on CBT payroll of $234,570,109 with $206M threshold and 20 percent rate as a first-time payor.
2018: The Yankees CBT payroll of $192,980,833 did not exceed the $197M threshold for MLB's competitive balance tax.
2017: $15,719,318 tax on CBT payroll of $224,224,707 with $195M threshold and 50 percent rate, plus surtax, as a 15-time payor.
2016: $27,396,653 tax on CBT payroll of $243,793,306 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 14-time payor.
2015: $26,108,784 tax on CBT payroll of $241,217,569 with $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as 13-time payor.
2014: $18,326,948 tax on CBT payroll of $225,653,896 wirh $189M threshold and 50 percent rate as a 12-time payor.
* Projected payroll for purposes of the Competitive Balance Tax under Article XXIII of MLB collective bargaining agreement. Estimated figures in italics.
* Figures include the average annual values of contracts for players on the 40-man roster, plus about $17M for benefits and $1.667M for 0- to 3-year player bonus pool.
* Tax rate based on number of consecutive seasons a club has exceeded the base tax threshold. Rate resets if club payroll falls below tax threshold for one season.
* First-Time Payor tax rates: 20% for exceeding threshold by $20M or less, 32% for exceeding by $20-$40M, 62.5% for exceeding by $40M-$60M, 80% for exceeding by $60M or more.
* Second-Time Payor tax rates: 30% for exceeding threshold by $20M or less, 42% for exceeding by $20-$40M, 75% for exceeding by $40M or more, 90% for exceeding by $60M or more.
* Third-Time Payor tax rates: 50% for exceeding threshold by $20M or less, 62% for exceeding by $20-$40M, 95% for exceeding by $40M or more, 110% for exceeding by $60M or more.
